relationships.subject: neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: excitatory postsynaptic potentials (EPSP) induced after stimulation of distal inputs were enlarged

key_findings: Neuropathic pain enlarges distal-input EPSPs in layer 5 cortico-striatal cACC neurons with intact intrinsic excitability and temporal summation.
Suggests synaptic rather than dendritic-integration mechanisms of plasticity.
